subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are seated around a square table, facing towards the center. Some of them are seated at the corners, while others are seated in the middle of the sides of the table. D is seated at the third position to the left of E. D is seated at one of the corners. H is not seated at any corner. G is seated at the second position to the right of H. H is not seated immediately next to D. There are exactly three persons between B and A. B is seated immediately next to F. B is not seated in the middle of any side. 

Who is seated at the third position to the left of G?
solution:
Given :

A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are seated around a square table, facing towards the center.

Some of them are seated at the corners, while others are seated in the middle of the sides of the table.

Explanation :

There are exactly three persons between B and A.

B is not seated in the middle of any side.

D is seated at the third position to the left of E. D is seated at one of the corners.
